component.name: Legend of Mana Native
component.summary: A native source port of Legend of Mana, for your own copy of the game

description.p: This is my native source port of Legend of Mana, built from lom-decomp. The game runs as a real program on your computer, not in an emulator.
It isn't finished. You can get into the game and play, but it hasn't been played all the way through yet and there are still bugs, so expect things to break.

You need your own copy of Legend of Mana, the US version (SLUS-01013) or the Japanese one (SLPS-02170), as a disc image or an extracted folder. No game data is included. The launcher checks your files against the real disc and sets them up, then you can play.
